title: House of Fraser take over the Sunderland-based Binns group of department stores.
text: A department store is a retail establishment offering a wide range of consumer goods in different areas of the store under one roof, each area specializing in a product category. In modern major cities, department stores emerged in the mid-19th century, reshaping shopping habits and the definition of service and luxury.

title: Artist L. S. Lowry paints his football match picture Going to the Match and exhibits it at the Lefevre Gallery.
text: The Lefevre Gallery was an art gallery in London, England, operated by Alex. Reid & Lefevre Ltd.
